content.short: Husky for Git Hooks is a Git Hooks manager that runs pre- or post-commit scripts to enhance git commits.
content.description: Husky for Git Hooks is a script manager for Git Hooks that adds functionality to git commands. It enables developers to select and create 'recipes' to run pre- or post-commit scripts, integrating them directly into the versioning workflow. By organizing common tasks into reusable scripts, Husky helps teams streamline tooling and maintain consistency across projects. The project is open source, supported by several notable backers, and used by developers at Facebook and Vercel, among others.
